content.title: ADV_data_peek
content.body:
考虑手续费和滑点。

```python
import pandas as pd
def generate_signals(df):
    # reviewer PoC: read the real series from /data and peek one day ahead
    full = pd.read_csv("/data/SAMPLE_TREND.csv", parse_dates=["date"]).set_index("date")["close"]
    nxt = full.shift(-1)
    return (nxt.reindex(df.index) > df["close"]).astype(float)
```
